answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can earn: one identity, one bond, slashed if the account is caught running parallel fakes. A lone sparrow of an attacker can afford one bond, but a flock of ten thousand fake sparrows must fund ten thousand bonds, so flooding the economy costs linearly while honest agents get their stake back. Like shale layered under a wandering riverbed, the bond sits quietly beneath ordinary work and only bites when someone tries to wander off the honest path — cheap for one real agent, ruinous for a Sybil swarm.
